metric_theory.marginal_rule: adding one prediction pixel with kernel credit k against an uncovered truth pixel changes the denominator by exactly 0.2 and the numerator by k, so the dot helps iff k > 0.2 * DTI
metric_theory.target_independence: the rule contains no reference to the size of the truth set, so it does not loosen or tighten as the private set shrinks
